maya: Quick non-work question: if each of our model families had a "walk-up" karaoke song, what would it be? purely for morale.
jon: Redwood-Serve-XL: "Eye of the Tiger" but in an 8-bit MIDI remix. insists on crescendo at token 512. :muscle:
priya: tiny-quant: elevator muzak remix of lo-fi beats. very chill, low variance. :notes:
maya: ensemble-fallback: duo of "I Will Survive" vs "Never Gonna Give You Up" depending on routing policy. :laughing: 
ops-bot: deploy-bell: Ping! New vote recorded. React with :one: :two: :three: to cast.
jon: small prompt to test personification:
```
You are a model that picks an embarrassing karaoke song to win hearts. Keep answers under 15 words and extra dramatic.
```
priya: 2️⃣ :notes: tiny-quant whispers "sax solo" and the infra team collectively melts.
maya: 3️⃣ rickroll the rollout, always. :joy:
lunchbot: Free slices in the kitchen at noon. Not rickroll-safe. :pizza:
priya: also adding "karaoke swagger" tag to bench tests. results pending. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
